name: Swappable Cards
description: Row of profile cards with photo background, status badge, rating, followers and a contact button. Cards can be reordered by dragging their handle, with a slow zoom on each photo.
contents: Optional header with title and subtitle
Profile cards with image, online status, name, verified tick, rating stars, follower count, description and action button
behavior: Cards fade in from blur with staggered delay
Card photo slowly zooms in and out
Hover on a card brightens the bottom fade and tints the button
Dragging the handle reorders cards, dropped card springs into place
Button presses scale with a spring release
editableByProps: Number of cards and all card text, images, ratings, status and button handlers
Background color, spacing, button hover color
Toggle drag reordering, hover glow and header
